notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.2
notes.content:
Bug Fixes/Changes:
- Fixed issue where entering a small room in level 2 crashed the game.
- Boss in survival levels no longer get deleted after the train comes back.
- Dialogue interactions now freezes the game.
- Interacting with the dummy is no longer required to start a level.
- You dash in the Hub level now.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - v1.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Additions[/h1]
[h2]Spook's Soda Mixer Station[/h2] 
[h3]What is it?[/h3]
Spook manages one of the last remaining soda machines in the world of Sluggerpunk, and it allows the player to create and carry a customized drink that buffs them temporarily.
[h3]Different Flavored Buffs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cherry - Increases player damage by 1.5x. Lasts 1 minute.
[*] Orange - Enemies spawn a baseball when they die. Lasts 45 seconds.
[*] Pineapple - 15% Chance to heal when hitting enemies. Lasts 20 seconds. 
[*] Lime - You can dash 25% further. Lasts 2 minutes. 
[/list]
[h2]New Abilities![/h2]
[h3]Billiard Blast Mask (Head)[/h3]
The player can hit billiard balls with their baseballs to make them burst into 8 baseballs that fly off in random directions.
[h3]Robo-Vac Cat (Head)[/h3]
A cat on a robotic vacuum cleaner that picks up coins.
[h3]Tennis Racket (Arm)[/h3]
Player can spawn a tennis ball projectile. If the tennis ball is struck, it auto-targets enemies after bouncing.

[h2]New Enemy[/h2]
[b]Aura Bot[/b] - Two baseball bats that protect it orbit around it, be wary of engaging in ranged combat with this enemy. 

[h2]New Levels![/h2]
+ Endless levels are now available (Black Train Lines) 
+ Added labels for the train selection menu
+ Tutorial level is now available, it is accessed through the train selection line.

[h1]Changes/Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adding money display to the Jukebox, as well as correctly labeling what kind of currency they consume.
[*] End screen and Leaderboards now display score.
[*] Line Selection now has a label on top so its harder to miss.
[*] Fixed UI timer counting while game was paused.
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - v1.0.4
notes.content:
Preparing the game to be playable on Steam Deck, and preparing for the first big update!
[h1]Changes/Fixes[/h1]
- Main menu no longer defaults to Windowed Mode if there are no save settings saved. 
- Adjusted descriptions of items to have more concise descriptions. 
- Moved jukebox in the hub level to prepare hub level for future patches.

notes.title: Patch Notes for Sluggerpunk v1.0.3
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes - v1.0.3[/h1]
[h2]Additions[/h2]
+ Added new interface for Techno Surgeon
+ Techno Surgeon can now grant armor to the player, allowing them to prevent damage for a few hits before breaking. 
[h2]Fixes/Changes[/h2]
~ Fixed the Grand Arena Collisions.
~ Fixed description in the Bestiary from continuing off screen.
~ Fixed Bestiary displaying incorrect information and added the name of enemies displayed above their description 
~ Fixed the chests and breakable walls rendering above the player on the yellow line.
~ Fixed chests on the green line from rendering above the player.
~ Set the stopwatch recharge visual indicator to 0.
- Removed the old inventory interface from the Techno Surgeon to prepare for his new interface.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - v1.0.2
notes.content:
[h1]PATCH NOTES - v1.0.2[/h1]
[h2]Additions[/h2]
+ New Item: Robot Arm (Torso Slot) - Once the Ancient Head is defeated in the Yellow Line, the player can take one of their arms for themselves! 
+ Ancient Head now drops Robot Arm item
[h2]Fixes/Changes[/h2]
~ Fixed exploit where players could increase their killstreak by hitting obstacles
~ All achievements should now be working
~ Fixed problem with Boss Health Bar blocking the train timer's UI element
~ Changed boss health bar sprite to be less intrusive
~ Fixed Grand Master not flashing white when hit
~ Fixed Ancient Head (and some other enemies) not displaying damage numbers when hit

notes.title: Sluggerpunk Build v1.0.1 - New Item + Bug Fixes + Quality of Life Changes!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch Notes for Version 1.0.1:[/b][/h1]
+ Added new item to the game: Motorcycle Helmet (Head Slot) - 10% chance to prevent incoming damage
+ Telebi now has dialogue displaying information about the different functions of the shop (refresh, insurance card, exit shop)
+ Ranged Drone Enemies now telegraph their projectile attacks
+ Added an arrow that points in the direction of the right analog stick. Controller Only.
~ Achievements for all items should now work
~ Saving is now encrypted
~ Grand Master level now displays HUD properly
~ Grand Master level is now slightly darker to better contrast entities on top
~ Grand Master and his chess pieces now have significantly more health
~ Chess Timer not doesn't affect the player in Grand Master fight, only the Grand Master's ability to spawn
~ Telebi's shop now refreshes with new items instead of ones the player might already have
~ Items in Telebi's shop now display what slot they belong to
~ Fixed Telebi crashing or showing broken enhancements when running out of options. Now it just displays an empty shop until there are items to sell again (whenever the player loses one, or when new items get added to the game) and fixed enhancements not loading properly in shop and inventory after JSON load.
~ Fixed Poker Chips not updating after buying Insurance.
~ Fixed the an issue with the keycard and a door in the Yellow Line level
~ Fixed issue with artificial heart, where hurtbox would be slightly offset downwards after reattaching back to the player
